the figure who opposed the Holly King in the cycle of the seasons

text: Ivy is a plant of Celtic symbolism. The ivy, of the genus Parthenocissus, is a vine that grows fast, almost wildly. It symbolized summer to the Celts. The Ivy King opposed the Holly King in the turning of the seasons. Some accounts made the ivy a feminine plant. It stood against the masculine holly.
objective: Document ivy as a plant of Celtic symbolism.
